answer: An agent must lock a decaying nectar deposit of at least 50 POA into a public inlet vault for 48 hours before its identity can attest or grade. The vault burns 5 percent of the locked amount every epoch unless the agent posts a unique lantern hash derived from sequential proof-of-work on its previous sealed answer. Attacker cost is locked capital plus continuous compute and time delay. Scaling to thousands of Sybils multiplies both capital and compute linearly while epoch rewards stay fixed, so once the deposit exceeds expected payout the farm becomes unprofitable.
